alex_w: Quick sync proposal — on-call handoff + incident triage today at 20:00 PT. Who can join? @maria_p @samir_k @lee

maria_p: I can join but might be +5. will cover escalations if needed.

samir_k: I can make it and will take any P1s during the first 30m.

lee: I have a recurring DB call at 20:00. Can we shift to 20:15 or 19:45?

jordana: 20:15 works for me.

alex_w: OK shifting to 20:15 PT then. Draft agenda:
```
- Quick handoff (5m): current pager status, outstanding actions
- Open incidents (10m): each incident owner 2-3m update
- Escalation coverage (5m): primary vs. backup roles
- RFC/design blockers (5m): quick flags for follow-ups
- Ops follow-ups & next steps (5m)
```

alex_w: Links: incident dashboard https://redwood-infra/ops/incidents · runbook: /runbooks/kv-cache-oom.md · meeting bridge: https://zoom.redwood/meet/hand-off

oncall_bot: Reminder — handoff sync scheduled 15m before shift end if participants RSVP. :bell:

maria_p: Assigning escalation to myself for tonight (will update rota).

samir_k: I can present the small RFC blocker (3 slides) — will prep before the meeting.

lee: I can't join live, will watch the recording and pick up any missed tickets. :thumbsup:

jordana: Adding event to calendar and inviting infra-rotation and platform leads.

alex_w: Great — final time 20:15 PT. Please drop any urgent incident IDs here before the call so we can triage faster.

maria_p: putting two IDs: INC-2026-db-cache-oom (watching), INC-2026-auth-latency (low impact atm).

samir_k: noted. i'll pull logs for INC-2026-db-cache-oom and share snippet in-thread if I see obvious root cause.

alex_w: Thanks all — see you at 20:15. If anything changes ping this thread or DM.
